# Rational equivalence is generated by pushed principal divisors

The rational-equivalence subgroup is equivalently generated, for every
integral subvariety `V` and every nonzero rational function `g` on its
normalization, by the pushed principal divisor

`nu_*(div(g))`.

This formulation fixes the codimension shift: divisors on an
`(r-1)`-codimensional subvariety generate relations among codimension-`r`
cycles.
